name: Hearts In Orbit: When Stars Align
source:
In the land of Astron, a legend tells the story of two stars who were in a passionate love, creating a binary star system. Despite their shared orbit, they would always push each other away, never embracing each other, for their love would burn too brightly and engulf all. The stars danced on for centuries, until one day, the Goddess asked them why they continued dancing despite never touching. 

"Because we must try. We have to keep trying" The stars replied in unison.

The Goddess's heart ached for the two stars, and witnessing the intensity of their love, she found herself moved to tears.

The Goddess offered to reincarnate them as humans in the next life, but warned them that they would not have memories of their current lives. If their love was true, they would meet again in their new lives. The stars agreed, knowing they'd always find each other in the end.

Some people believe those two stars are out there, watching over Astron, while others believe they truly did reincarnate among us. 

Will they ever embrace? No one knows for sure...

[Edited from [url=https://ashelucia.itch.io/heartsinorbit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在Astron的土地上，有一个传说，讲述了两颗恒星的热烈爱情，创造了双星系统的故事。尽管他们有着共同的轨道，但他们总是互相推开，从不拥抱对方，因为他们的爱会燃烧得太明亮，吞噬一切。星星们跳舞了几个世纪，直到有一天，女神问他们为什么尽管从未接触过，但仍继续跳舞。

“因为我们必须尝试。我们必须继续努力。”星星们异口同声地回答。

女神为两位明星心痛，目睹他们的爱情之深，她感动得热泪盈眶。

女神提出让他们来世转世为人，但警告他们不会有今生的记忆。如果他们的爱情是真的话，他们会在新的生活中再次相遇。星星们同意了，因为他们知道他们最终总会找到彼此。

有些人相信这两颗星星就在那里，守护着Astron，而另一些人则相信他们确实在我们中间转世。

他们会拥抱吗？没有人确切知道…
